# 2014–15 Danish 1st Division

The 2014–15 Danish 1st Division (known in Danish as the **1. division**) was the second tier of Danish football, sitting below the Superliga and above the 2nd Division in the Danish football pyramid.

## Overview

The Danish 1st Division serves as the first division below the top-flight Superliga. Clubs compete for promotion to the Superliga, while the bottom clubs face relegation to the 2nd Division.

## Format

The league typically features **12 teams** competing in a round-robin format over the course of the season. The top finisher(s) earn promotion or a playoff opportunity for the Superliga, while the bottom teams are relegated.

## Season Details

- The season ran during the **2014–15 football calendar**, generally spanning from mid-2014 through spring 2015, following the Danish football season structure.
- Promotion playoffs were a feature of the system, where 1st Division clubs could compete against Superliga clubs for top-flight places.
